caption: The drawing depicts three different views of a single round, lidded container made of wood. The container is shown with the lid on (top view), the container alone with the interior visible (middle view), and the lid detached and lying flat (bottom view). The container is decorated on the exterior with a dark blue or black base color and painted with yellow-green script and patterns; the script on the side in the first view appears to read “SLDF” and in the second view reads “1866.” The exterior is additionally adorned with large, stylized red and yellow floral or starburst motifs, particularly visible on the sides and on the lid. The wooden edge of the container and the lid are brown, and the interior of the container is shown as a lighter, natural wood color. The lid has a large, decorative, circular metal handle at the center, attached with a ring in a floral pattern. Handles or supports are also visible on either side of the container and lid. The artist's name, “Harry Grossen,” is written in the lower right corner of the image. The background of the drawing is a light, off-white color.
title: Butter Box
